question: Which part of a CPU coordinates all the functions of a computer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Control unit**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Control unit** is a component of a computer's central processing unit (CPU).
 
• It directs the operation of the processor by telling the computer's memory, arithmetic/logic unit, and input and output devices how to respond to the instructions that have been sent to the processor.
